notes.title: Physics Rapid Sign Convention & Lens Power Check
notes.content: Mirror Formula: 1/v + 1/u = 1/f | Lens Formula: 1/v - 1/u = 1/f | Magnification (Mirror): m = -v/u | Power P = 1/f (in metres, Dioptre). Concave focal length is always negative (-); Convex is positive (+).

notes.title: Maths Trigonometry, AP & Coordinate High-Yield Formulas
notes.content: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 | 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ | 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ | AP nth term: aₙ = a + (n-1)d | Sum: Sₙ = (n/2)[2a + (n-1)d] | Section Formula: ((m₁x₂ + m₂x₁)/(m₁+m₂), (m₁y₂ + m₂y₁)/(m₁+m₂)).

notes.title: Chemistry Reactivity Series & Carbon Reactions
